d: THE SIGNALBEARERS #1 — Relay of Signals. The call comes at low tide: the Signal Spire needs Illmir. Starring Illmir (Tamere Ohal), Vavix (Galbex Setine). A team of cosmic guardians keeps the beacon-network of the far colonies lit — and something out in the dark keeps trying to snuff it.

EMBERFALL #1 — The Pale Vale. The call comes at low tide: Cinderhold Keep needs Rhekaor. Starring Rhekaor (Joglen Helmir), Pharaka (Rinor Sedine). In a valley of ash and frost, young wardens carry living ember-flames between the last warm holds of the Vale.

THE HOLLOW CIRCUIT #1 — Ghosts of Sector Nine. Rherine spots it first: scorch marks in a perfect ring, at the edge of Sector Nine rooftops. Starring Olrine (Galston Delglen), Rherine (Ibex Belglen), Sylrakia (Luhal Shamere). Neon-row couriers who dive the city's ghost frequencies discover a signal that was never meant to be heard.

TIDEBOUND #1 — Onphora's Crossing. Onphora hurries toward open water past Gullrest, tide reading flaring. Starring Onphora (Belnor Lobris), Ulrakia (Rohollow Rifell), Quolmir (Senor Setal). Harbor kids and old sailors bound by tide-oaths guard the sea-roads between Gullrest and the drowned places.

THE GLOAMING WATCH #1 — Shadows over Gloam City. the blue hour over Gloam City — and Rherine is already exactly on time. Starring Rherine (Inor Zemere), Kaalmir (Helsha Nabris). Lantern-keepers patrol the fog city after dark, solving the small strange mysteries the daylight misses.

STARFARER'S LOG #1 — The Signal Reef. low tide over the Far Cartography — and Ulsel is already three steps ahead. Starring Ulsel (Inor Even), Nydoraus (Asha Kasor), Vadoraia (Fasor Delhal). An anthology of voyages: the survey ship Wayfarer charts the far dark, one strange world per issue.

THE CLOCKWORK MENAGERIE #1 — Steam over Cogsworth. The call comes at the blue hour: the Tinker's Market needs Quokaia. Starring Quokaia (Pasor Natine), Quorine (Nafaro Galbris), Drexoria (Pafaro Lofaro), Rhelmirus (Pabris Omar). Tinkerers and their brass automatons keep the gear-city wound — and someone keeps loosening the springs.

Starring Olmaraia (Jotine Rithon), Quophore (Galtal Lumar), Thalnethe (Amere Lotal). The Maple Street kids and their treehouse club: small heroes, big heart, everyday wonders.
